scientific_integrity: The exact finite enumerative statements follow from opposite-sector pairing and a uniform-permutation bijection. scientific_limitations: Uniform cyclic perfect matchings only; no claim for weighted matchings or all high-degree levels.
Historical priority may be affected by older equivalent permutation block or refined crossing enumerations.
Conditional central limit theorem is qualitative, without an error rate.
